question: Must this external PR provide a redacted live Discord Gateway/REST or final agent-context capture, or will maintainers explicitly accept the deterministic production-path integration test as sufficient proof?
rationale: Repository review policy treats tests and mocked REST clients as supplemental rather than real behavior proof, so waiving the live-evidence gate requires explicit maintainer judgment.

options.title: Require live Discord proof
options.body: Keep the PR blocked until a redacted real Discord run demonstrates the double omission and recovered quoted context at the agent boundary.

options.title: Accept deterministic proof
options.body: A maintainer may explicitly accept the production-module integration test and documented Discord API contract despite the absence of a live token-backed capture.

recommendation.title: Require live Discord proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR blocked until a redacted real Discord run demonstrates the double omission and recovered quoted context at the agent boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current reply hydration behavior and are best positioned to assess whether the new fallback is adequately proven against that boundary.
